body.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer for AI Forex App
body.aiReason: Job aligns with AI, Python, SQL, data pipelines, and some React/JS experience; appears genuine and detailed, no red flags.
body.description:
I am looking for an experienced full-stack developer to build  a serious AI-powered trading analysis platform for forex and synthetic index traders.
I previously attempted to build the application using an AI app builder, but the result did not meet the standard I was looking for. I now want an experienced developer who can take the product idea and build a proper, functional and scalable application.
This is not simply an AI chatbot.
Pipsy should combine real market data, technical analysis, price action and AI reasoning to help traders analyze potential trading setups.
I am looking for someone who understands both software development and trading/technical analysis.
What I Want to Build
Pipsy AI should work as an intelligent trading analysis assistant.
A user should be able to select a trading instrument, view the chart and ask Pipsy to analyze the market.
The application should be able to identify and explain things such as:
Market structure
Trend
Support and resistance
Price action
Swing highs and lows
Break of Structure (BOS)
Change of Character (CHoCH)
Liquidity
Liquidity sweeps
Order Blocks
Fair Value Gaps (FVG)
Supply and demand
Imbalances
Candlestick patterns
Multi-timeframe structure
Potential entry areas
Stop-loss areas
Take-profit targets
Risk-to-reward
Trade invalidation
Confluence between different factors
The goal is to create a product that gives traders structured analysis rather than generic AI trading advice.
Pipsy AI Assistant
Pipsy should be the main AI component of the platform.
Users should be able to ask questions such as:
"Analyze EURUSD."
"What is the current market structure?"
"Where is the liquidity?"
"Is there a potential setup?"
"Where is the best entry zone?"
"Where should my stop loss be?"
"What could invalidate this setup?"
"What is the risk-to-reward?"
"Analyze this setup using price action."
"Give me a multi-timeframe analysis."
Pipsy should provide a clear explanation of its analysis.
For example:
Market: EURUSD
Bias: Bullish
Market Structure: Bullish
Liquidity: Sell-side liquidity swept
Order Block: Identified
FVG: Identified
Entry Zone: XXX–XXX
Stop Loss: XXX
Take Profit: XXX
Risk/Reward: 1:3
Invalidation: XXX
The exact format can be improved by the developer.
Importantly, Pipsy should also be able to say "No valid setup" when the required conditions are not present.
I do not want the system forcing a trade signal simply because the user asked for one.
Technical Analysis Engine
A major requirement is that the application should not rely entirely on an LLM to interpret everything.
I want a proper technical-analysis layer that processes market data and provides structured information to the AI.
The architecture should ideally work like:
Market Data → Technical Analysis → Structured Market Context → AI Reasoning → User
The developer should determine the best implementation.
The system should be designed to support:
OHLC/candlestick data
Market structure
BOS
CHoCH
Swing points
Liquidity zones
Liquidity sweeps
Order Blocks
Fair Value Gaps
Supply/Demand
Support/Resistance
Trend
Volatility
Multiple timeframes
The AI should use this structured information rather than simply inventing
